title: heartbeat.json of a run
description: Proof of progress of a running conductor (<run>/heartbeat.json), replaced atomically by the conductor's own thread of control (every progress line, every look at a running role or check, every blocking call with a known limit); never by a timer thread, so a stuck main loop shows. The lease proves who owns the run, the heartbeat that the owner still moves. Read by status and runs (orch.conductor.health.classify); a missing or unreadable heartbeat never stops a run.

start_ticks.description: Start time of the conductor in clock ticks since boot (/proc/<pid>/stat), null when it could not be read.

seq.description: Number of this write within the process (1, 2, ...).

item.description: Piece being conducted, null outside a piece.

step.description: Step being conducted (executor.1, checks.1, ...), null outside a step.

role.description: Role of the step, null outside a role.

last_progress_at.description: UTC time of the last sign of progress.

stream_bytes.description: Size of the stream of the running role (or the log of the running check).

last_growth_at.description: UTC time the stream last grew.

tree_cpu_s.description: CPU seconds (user + system) of the process tree of the running role or check at the last measure.

last_cpu_at.description: UTC time the CPU of the tree last grew.

repeat.description: The command the running role repeats: its last tool command and how many times in a row.

count.description: How many times in a row.

waiting.description: A blocking call with a known limit that is in progress (null: none). Inside its deadline a silent heartbeat is not a hang.

deadline.description: UTC time the wait is expected to be over; required for every kind but question.
